    split_ifs with h

    · -- Case: x ≠ 0
      have h₁ : (3 * x) / 3 = x := by
        -- Prove that (3 * x) / 3 = x for x ≠ 0
        have h₂ : x ≠ 0 := by simpa using h
        have h₃ : (3 * x) / 3 = x := by
          omega
        exact h₃
      have h₂ : (3 * x) / 3 * 3 = 3 * x := by
        -- Prove that ((3 * x) / 3) * 3 = 3 * x
        have h₃ : (3 * x) / 3 * 3 = 3 * x := by
          omega
        exact h₃
      simp_all (config := {decide := true}) <;> omega
  exact h_main
